items.title: Amalek
items.charge: Attacking Israel's stragglers on the way out of Egypt

items.title: Babylon, the lady of kingdoms
items.charge: Showing no mercy to the captives; saying, I am, and none else beside me; trusting in her sorceries

items.title: Eglon king of Moab
items.charge: Possessing the city of palm trees and taking tribute of Israel eighteen years

items.title: Hazael king of Syria
items.charge: Smothering his master to take the throne, and doing to Israel the evil Elisha wept over

items.title: Heliodorus
items.charge: Attempting to plunder the temple treasury

items.title: Jabin and Sisera
items.charge: Mightily oppressing Israel twenty years with nine hundred chariots of iron

items.title: Pharaoh of the Exodus
items.charge: Oppressing Israel; drowning their sons; refusing the Lord's command

items.title: The adversaries of Judah and Benjamin
items.charge: Weakening the hands of the people; hiring counsellors against them to frustrate the building of the house of God

items.title: The nobles who exacted usury of their brethren
items.charge: Lending on interest; taking brethren's lands and children for debt

items.title: The scribes and Pharisees
items.charge: Shutting up the kingdom against men; devouring widows' houses; tithing mint and omitting judgment, mercy and faith; whited sepulchres

items.title: The shepherds of Israel
items.charge: Feeding themselves and not the flock; scattering the sheep
